name: mcp_1inch
description: Explore swap protocols, market data, portfolios, and wallet-assisted workflows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Use a 1inch API key. Wallet signing remains separate.

name: mcp_1password
description: Manage 1Password Environments and variable names through the local desktop app.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: The official server runs locally over stdio inside the 1Password desktop app, with desktop approval prompts. It manages Environments and variable names, never returns secret values, and does not support remote-only clients such as AutoGPT.

name: mcp_aave
description: Inspect lending markets and wallet positions, and prepare unsigned transactions.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Public market tools require no sign-in. Sign any transaction separately in your wallet.

name: mcp_agentmail
description: Work with agent inboxes, messages, drafts, threads, and attachments.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to AgentMail and choose the organization to connect.

name: mcp_ahrefs
description: Research SEO keywords, backlinks, and rankings.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Ahrefs does not permit custom programmatic MCP clients. Use its supported clients or public API.

name: mcp_aikido
description: Scan source code for security issues and exposed secrets.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires the local Aikido MCP process and a personal access token. Follow the vendor's coding-tool setup.

name: mcp_airtable
description: Search bases and manage records and schemas within your Airtable permissions.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Airtable and authorize the bases you want to access.

name: mcp_airwallex_agentos
description: Work with production billing, issuing, treasury, and supported payment workflows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in with a production Airwallex account. Available actions depend on account permissions; money-out tools are not enabled by default.

name: mcp_airwallex_developer
description: Use the separate Developer MCP to explore APIs and test sandbox integrations.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in with an Airwallex sandbox account. This server provides documentation and sandbox testing tools; production account operations use the separate AgentOS server.

name: mcp_aleph
description: Query governed financial data and support spreadsheet analysis.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Aleph publishes an MCP endpoint in its official plugin, but does not publish a custom-client authentication and setup guide. This undocumented connection is not available in AutoGPT.

name: mcp_algolia_productivity
description: Read search indexes, results, facets, recommendations, and analytics.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Enable MCP in your Algolia dashboard, then sign in. This connection provides read-only tools.

name: mcp_amazon_location_service
description: Access geocoding, place search, and route tools through the local Amazon Location MCP package.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: The official Amazon Location MCP package runs locally over stdio with an AWS credential profile. AutoGPT cannot launch this local process. The general AWS MCP server is a separate integration.

name: mcp_amplemarket
description: Research prospects and companies, and manage sales lists and sequences.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in with an active Amplemarket account. Your existing account permissions apply.

name: mcp_amplitude
description: Explore product analytics, charts, dashboards, cohorts, and experiments.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to an Amplitude US account. For EU data, use a custom connection with the EU endpoint from the documentation.

name: mcp_ando
description: Read and participate in conversations, messages, files, and inbox workflows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in as an Ando member. Live event delivery and agent self-onboarding require separate setup.

name: mcp_antimetal
description: Investigate operational issues using runtime context and root-cause analysis.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Paste an Antimetal API key as the access token.

name: mcp_apify
description: Discover and run scraping and extraction Actors, and read their results.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Apify to run Actors and access account data. Actor runs may incur usage charges.

name: mcp_apollo_io
description: Find and enrich sales contacts and use supported engagement workflows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Apollo. Account features and enrichment credits apply; comply with Apollo's model-training restrictions.

name: mcp_appwrite
description: Manage Appwrite project databases, users, storage, teams, and functions.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Appwrite Cloud. Self-hosted installations need the vendor's separate setup.

name: mcp_arize
description: Search public Arize documentation for tracing and instrumentation guidance.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: This is the public documentation server, not a connection to private AX telemetry. Local instrumentation tooling requires separate setup.

name: mcp_asana
description: Work with Asana tasks, projects, and workspaces.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Asana requires a pre-registered MCP app with a client ID and secret. The current dialog cannot supply these credentials.

name: mcp_astronomer
description: Read Astro Deployments, Workspaces, environment objects, and organization settings.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Ask your Astronomer account team to enable Astro MCP in Labs, then sign in with your Astro credentials. This connects the account control plane; it does not connect the experimental public Registry or an Airflow deployment plugin.

name: mcp_atlan
description: Search governed metadata, lineage, glossary terms, and supported catalog actions.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Atlan. Tenant policies, personas, and existing permissions govern available tools.

name: mcp_atlassian
description: Search and work across Jira, Confluence, and Atlassian Teamwork Graph through Rovo MCP.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Your organization admin must allow your AutoGPT origin in the Rovo MCP domain allowlist before OAuth sign-in. If the admin enables API-token authentication, Basic authentication with your Atlassian email and API token is also supported. Product permissions and Rovo credit limits apply.

name: mcp_atlassian_forge
description: Search public Forge documentation, modules, and manifest guidance.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Documentation only. This server cannot access local files, execute the Forge CLI, or deploy apps.

name: mcp_aws_core
description: Use the general AWS MCP server for AWS service APIs and guidance within your IAM permissions.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: AWS permits browser OAuth only for approved clients. Use an AWS identity with signin:CreateOAuth2Token and obtain an access token with: aws signin create-oauth2-token-with-iam --grant-type client_credentials --resource aws-mcp.amazonaws.com --region us-east-1. Paste the returned access token as Bearer. It expires within one hour and must be replaced manually; AutoGPT does not renew it.

name: mcp_aws_data_analytics
description: Manage Glue, EMR, and Athena with the local AWS Data Processing MCP package.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: The official Data Processing MCP package runs locally over stdio with AWS credentials. AutoGPT cannot launch this local process. It is separate from the general AWS MCP server.

name: mcp_aws_databases
description: Search AWS documentation and guidance for AWS Agents, AWS Databases, AWS Deployments, and AWS Amplify.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Public documentation and guidance only; no AWS account is required. This server cannot query your databases, deploy resources, or operate agents. Those tasks need separate authenticated services.

name: mcp_aws_sagemaker
description: Manage SageMaker HyperPod clusters through the local SageMaker AI MCP package.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: The official SageMaker AI MCP package runs locally with Python and an AWS credential profile. AutoGPT cannot launch this local process. It is separate from the general AWS MCP server.

name: mcp_azure_cosmos_db
description: Query documents and schemas, including vector and hybrid search.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Deploy the official Cosmos DB MCP Toolkit in your Azure environment, then enter its HTTPS endpoint and Entra access token. Configure managed identity and database permissions.

name: mcp_bird
description: Use supported customer-communication tools through Bird's official server.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Bird and authorize the relevant workspace.

name: mcp_brevo
description: Work with contacts, campaigns, and supported messaging workflows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: In Brevo, open Account > SMTP & API > API Keys and create a key with the MCP option enabled. Paste that dedicated MCP token as the access token; a standard API key is not sufficient.

name: mcp_brex
description: Inspect expenses, receipts, bills, cards, and supported financial workflows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: An account or card admin must enable Brex in AI assistants under Settings > Early access and accept the Developer API agreement under Settings > Developer. Then sign in with your Brex account; existing roles and permissions apply.

name: mcp_browserbase
description: Run cloud browser sessions and browser-automation tools.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Browserbase requires an API key in a special connection URL. The current dialog does not support that authentication flow.

name: mcp_calendly
description: Check scheduling availability and manage supported bookings.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Calendly and authorize your account.

name: mcp_chargebee
description: Use billing knowledge, account-data lookup, or test-site onboarding tools.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Copy the Data Lookup MCP endpoint from your Chargebee tenant settings and paste an authorized API key as the access token. Public Knowledge Base and onboarding tools use separate servers.

name: mcp_clay
description: Research and enrich companies and people through Clay workflows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Your workspace admin must allow Unknown clients under MCP users > Allowed MCP clients for AutoGPT dynamic registration. Sign in as a workspace member; this policy also applies when tokens refresh.

name: mcp_coda
description: Search and work with Coda documents, tables, and rows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Coda and authorize the documents you want to access.

name: mcp_composio
description: Access connected app tools through Composio's managed gateway.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Composio sessions require session configuration and authentication headers that AutoGPT cannot supply. Its separate single-toolkit MCP also requires user context and an x-api-key header by default.

name: mcp_context_dev
description: Search, crawl, scrape, and extract web content.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Context.dev and authorize the connection.

name: mcp_context7
description: Retrieve current, version-specific documentation for software libraries.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in through the dedicated OAuth endpoint. This connection provides library documentation.

name: mcp_craft
description: Read and edit Craft documents and connected workspace content.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Craft and select the space to authorize. Each connection accesses one space; scoped document connections use separately generated links.

name: mcp_crustdata
description: Search and enrich people and companies, including jobs and social activity.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in with your Crustdata account. A Crustdata API key as a Bearer token is also supported for programmatic access. Account credits apply.

name: mcp_customer_io
description: Work with Customer.io workspace data and supported messaging workflows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: An account admin must enable Customer.io MCP under Settings > AI. Then sign in and select your US workspace and permissions. For EU workspaces, select Customer.io (EU).

name: mcp_customer_io_eu
description: Work with Customer.io workspace data and supported messaging workflows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: An account admin must enable Customer.io MCP under Settings > AI. Then sign in and select your EU workspace and permissions. For US workspaces, select Customer.io (US).

name: mcp_datarobot
description: Access DataRobot's managed Global MCP tools.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Enter your DataRobot deployment URL ending in /api/v2/genai/globalmcp/mcp and a Bearer API token with the required scope. Other templates may need unsupported extra headers.

name: mcp_docusign
description: Search agreements and inspect envelopes and supported agreement workflows.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Developer connections require a Docusign integration key and secret. The current dialog cannot configure those OAuth client credentials.

name: mcp_finances_plaid
description: Inspect Plaid Dashboard integration diagnostics and developer activity.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: This is Plaid Dashboard tooling, not a personal-finance account connector. Production approval and a short-lived client-credentials flow are required.

name: mcp_firetiger
description: Query telemetry and manage investigations and agent sessions.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in with your Firetiger account. For API-key authentication, create a read-write key and paste the complete Basic authorization value from the reveal dialog; read-only keys cannot access this endpoint.

name: mcp_function_health
description: Explore available lab results and supported health-data context.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Use a Function-supported AI connector. The published endpoint does not provide a working custom-client authorization flow for AutoGPT.

name: mcp_gmail
description: Read and manage Gmail messages through Google's MCP developer preview.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires preview enrollment, an enabled Google Cloud project, and your own OAuth client ID and secret. Use the native Gmail integration where available.

name: mcp_gojiberry_ai
description: Connect AI workflows to Gojiberry sales and lead-research tools.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Paste your Gojiberry API key as the access token.

name: mcp_gong
description: Retrieve account, conversation, and deal context from Gong.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: A Gong Tech admin must create an MCP integration with Automatic registration and add the exact OAuth callback URL for your AutoGPT deployment. Then sign in with a paid Gong seat and available credits. Manual registration requires client credentials that AutoGPT cannot configure.

name: mcp_google_calendar
description: Manage calendars and events through Google's MCP developer preview.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires preview enrollment and a configured Google Cloud OAuth client. Use the native Google Calendar integration where available.

name: mcp_google_contacts
description: Access contacts through Google's People MCP developer preview.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires preview enrollment, API enablement, and your own Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret.

name: mcp_google_docs
description: Read and edit documents through Google's MCP developer preview.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires preview enrollment and your own Google Cloud OAuth client. Use the native Google Docs integration where available.

name: mcp_google_drive
description: Manage files through Google's MCP developer preview.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires preview enrollment and your own Google Cloud OAuth client. Use the native Google Drive integration where available.

name: mcp_google_sheets
description: Read and update spreadsheets through Google's MCP developer preview.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires preview enrollment and your own Google Cloud OAuth client. Use the native Google Sheets integration where available.

name: mcp_google_slides
description: Read and update presentations through Google's MCP developer preview.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires preview enrollment, API enablement, and your own Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret.

name: mcp_granola
description: Search meeting notes, transcripts, folders, and related context.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Granola and authorize your meeting data.

name: mcp_harmonic
description: Research companies, people, and investors, and manage research lists.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Use Harmonic's OAuth sign-in. API-key authentication uses a custom header that this dialog does not support.

name: mcp_healthex
description: Query patient health records and refresh connected record sources.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: HealthEx must whitelist a custom client before patient authorization. Contact the vendor and follow its integration guide.

name: mcp_hubspot
description: Search CRM data and use supported contact, activity, and content actions.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires a HubSpot MCP Auth App with its own client ID and secret. The current dialog cannot supply these credentials; use the native HubSpot integration where available.

name: mcp_infobip
description: Connect to product-specific messaging, customer-profile, or account tools.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Choose a documented Infobip product endpoint, such as SMS or email, and use OAuth. API-key authentication with Authorization: App is not supported here.

name: mcp_intercom
description: Search support conversations and contacts, and work with Help Center articles.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to a US-hosted Intercom workspace. For EU-hosted workspaces, select Intercom (EU). Australian workspaces are not currently supported.

name: mcp_intercom_eu
description: Search support conversations and contacts, and work with Help Center articles.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to an EU-hosted Intercom workspace. For US-hosted workspaces, select Intercom (US). Australian workspaces are not currently supported.

name: mcp_langfuse
description: Work with project traces, prompts, datasets, evaluations, and dashboards.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Choose your Langfuse region or self-hosted HTTPS endpoint ending in /api/public/mcp. Enter Basic followed by base64(publicKey:secretKey), rather than a bare API key.

name: mcp_mobbin
description: Find real-world UI references and screen images.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in with a Mobbin Pro, Team, or Enterprise account.

name: mcp_notion
description: Search and edit workspace pages and databases.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Notion and authorize workspace access. Enterprise workspaces may require an owner or admin to approve AutoGPT under the allowed AI apps policy. The hosted server uses user OAuth, not a personal API token.

name: mcp_onedrive
description: Access file and folder tools through Microsoft Work IQ preview.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing, tenant application registration, and admin consent. The current dialog cannot complete that custom OAuth setup.

name: mcp_opsera
description: Use DevSecOps investigation, architecture, compliance, and security tools.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in with your Opsera account in the browser. Connected tools and organization policies determine available actions; local IDE scanning and plugin workflows require their separate development environment.

name: mcp_outlook_calendar
description: Manage events and scheduling through Microsoft Work IQ preview.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing, a tenant application, and consent. The current dialog cannot supply the required custom OAuth client.

name: mcp_outlook_mail
description: Work with messages and drafts through Microsoft Work IQ preview.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing, a tenant application, and consent. The current dialog cannot supply the required custom OAuth client.

name: mcp_parallel
description: Search the web and extract content through Parallel Search MCP.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Parallel. Deep research and enrichment use its separate Task MCP.

name: mcp_plain
description: Manage support threads, replies, customers, labels, and Help Center content.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in with your Plain account. OAuth must authorize openid and offline_access; your existing workspace permissions apply.

name: mcp_runlayer
description: Discover and access tools through your organization's managed MCP catalog.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Copy the HTTPS proxy URL from your Runlayer Plugin or connector page, then sign in through your organization OAuth/SSO. Your organization must permit the client and upstream tools. Local connectors that require the Runlayer CLI are not supported by AutoGPT.

name: mcp_shadcn_ui
description: Find UI components and install them into a local coding project.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires a local project and the shadcn MCP process. This cloud integration dialog cannot install components in a coding workspace.

name: mcp_slack
description: Search and work with messages, channels, files, canvases, and lists.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Slack requires a registered internal or Marketplace app with a fixed OAuth client ID and secret. Use the native Slack integration where available.

name: mcp_sourcegraph
description: Search repositories, read code, and retrieve cross-repository context.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Enter your Sourcegraph instance URL ending in /.api/mcp or /.api/mcp/all. The admin must keep mcp.enabled and auth.idpDynamicClientRegistrationEnabled enabled, and your role needs MCP#ACCESS. Use OAuth; Sourcegraph access tokens use Authorization: token, which AutoGPT does not support.

name: mcp_subtext
description: Inspect session replay, UI snapshots, and privacy rules.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Subtext. Configure the capture snippet in your application to make session recordings available.

name: mcp_superme
description: Find expert profiles and converse with SuperMe agents.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in with your SuperMe account through OAuth. SuperMe supports dynamic client registration and PKCE; there is no API key to paste.

name: mcp_tabnine
description: Search enterprise repositories with the Tabnine Context Engine MCP service.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Obtain the remote MCP HTTPS endpoint and personal access token for your Tabnine enterprise instance. The separate local Tabnine Context Engine CLI is not installed or run by this connection.

name: mcp_treg
description: Discover and call tools through the Treg catalog and team gateway.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Paste a Treg dashboard API key scoped to your team as the access token. A team-scoped key works as a Bearer token without additional headers. Usage is charged against your team balance where applicable.

name: mcp_wonder
description: Read and edit canvas designs, components, and design documentation.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Sign in to Wonder. An existing project or file is required.

name: mcp_zoom
description: Access product-specific meeting, chat, and whiteboard tools.

mcp_server.setup_instructions: Requires a Zoom Marketplace app with its own OAuth client ID and secret, plus token refresh handling. The current dialog cannot configure that OAuth client.
